rate_limits: Without app token: lower shared IP-based throttling. With app token: ordinarily not throttled except for abuse/malicious traffic controls (no fixed published hourly quota). Exact Chicago-specific numbers not always published.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: auditor correct. Socrata docs state unauthenticated requests use a lower shared pool and token-bearing requests are ordinarily not throttled except abuse controls; no fixed ~1,000/hour unauthenticated quota in current policy (https://dev.socrata.com/docs/app-tokens.html). example.request: auditor correct. Double-quoted URL lets shells expand $limit; single-quote or escape $ (same docs / SoQL $limit usage).
